evidence.review_notes: Confirmed on Semitronix FY2025 annual report p31 (pdftotext -layout), upper 分地区营业收入构成-style table (境内/境外 revenue with % of total and YoY growth, continuing from p30): row 712,893,117.58 (97.00% of FY2025 revenue). Cross-footed: 境内+境外 for each year reproduces the lower 10%-threshold table's 分客户所处行业 集成电路行业 total exactly (FY2025: 712,893,117.58+22,084,155.47=734,977,273.05, which also equals the sum of the four quarterly 营业收入 figures printed earlier on the page), and the printed YoY growth (33.37% for 境内, 78.66% for 境外) reproduces exactly from the FY2025 and FY2024 values. This is a revenue-only (no cost) table, distinct from the lower 10%-threshold table that also prints 境内's cost and margin -- correctly extracted as a separate row rather than conflated with it.

notes: Semitronix 营业收入整体情况 table's 分地区 sub-row.
